name: io.github.hzxwonder/dsh-mcp
title: DeepSeek Harness for Codex
description: Delegate bounded tasks to local DeepSeek Harness with an explicit project_root in every tool call.

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Key for a compatible Messages API provider. Pass this secret through the environment, not command arguments.

environmentVariables.name: DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Messages API root. Requests use /v1/messages. An OpenAI chat-completions-only endpoint is not compatible.
